title: viola odorata subsp. collina
intro: Viola odorata subsp. collina, commonly known as the alpine violet, is a subspecies of the sweet violet plant, belonging to the Viola genus and native to mountainous regions in Europe. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including its ability to treat anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola odorata subsp. collina include its sedative, spasmolytic, and expectorant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, such as kaempferol, quercetin, and vanillin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
